notes: Background: Coppergate builds an in-app analytics assistant and a contextual code-assistant for customers; currently using OpenAI API for both chat and embeddings.
Primary goal: migrate from current provider to Redwood Hosted initially; target Dedicated within 6-9 months for cost predictability and VPC isolation.

Requirements summary: p95 chat latency <= 250ms (target 150ms for core flows), embeddings similarity delta < 0.02 cosine vs baseline, streaming & function-calling parity, webhook reliability, strong audit logs and KMS support.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Team estimates current monthly spend ~$18k. Looking for 30-50% unit cost improvement at Dedicated commit levels.

POC setup: Hosted POC spun up 2025-01-25 with compatibility shim (OpenAI completions + functions mimic). Ran 10k test prompts across 5 prompt families (support chat, product-guidance, summary, codegen, search rerank).

Observed regressions in Hosted POC: small hallucination increase on code-assistant prompts (~2.8% -> 4.1%), embeddings mean cosine drift +0.03 on longer docs, stop-sequence handling differs (needs shim), temperature/penalty param mapping inconsistent for a few prompts.

SE notes: recommend a compatibility layer that maps current SDK calls to Redwood semantics (stop tokens, function-calling envelope) + an automated prompt-parity test harness. Marcus building tests to 1) detect async streaming deltas 2) compare tokenization and stop behavior.
Security: security team requested SOC2 evidence (provided), KMS integration architecture diagram (requested for Dedicated), data residency confirmation for EU customers (Coppergate has EU clients).
Commercial: exploring a 12-month Dedicated commit with 3-month ramp. Pricing ask: illustrative term sheet requested 2025-02-18 (pending). They want unit price + committed throughput + burst policy.
Customer quote (AE notes): "We need to be confident prompts behave exactly the same — small drift breaks downstream heuristics and metrics."
Open items: finalize embedding similarity threshold, verify function-calling nested JSON behavior, confirm fallbacks for capacity (route to Hosted in cross-region outage).
